messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: sustained TPM spike for model family 'zephyr7b' (5m avg TPM +420%). Error rate (5xx) up from 0.2% -> 1.8%. Paging on-call.
alice-oncall: noticed, I'm on it. paging @ben-sre and @carmen-runtime. opening thread for live mitigation — will coordinate per-model quota changes.
ben-sre: looking now. seeing backend queuing on kv-cache fills and increased tail latency. risk of cascade if we keep current TPM. recommend immediate throttling of zephyr7b TPM and disabling funcall for that family to reduce external call amplification.
carmen-runtime: I can apply a surgical per-model quota and toggle funcall. propose: TPM 8000 -> 1800, RPM 480000 -> 108000, and set funcall.disable: zephyr7b=true for 30m. That should cut burst pressure and give time for cache pressure to drain.
alice-oncall: agree with plan. any customer-critical tenants pinned to zephyr7b we need to exempt?
dan-custsuccess: quick check — two enterprise tenants (Acera Inc, FinRed) have traffic using zephyr7b, but both have fallback model routes configured; FinRed uses zephyr7b for embeddings only in a non-critical pipeline. I'll DM them and post status.
carmen-runtime: command I'll run (admin CLI):
```
redwood-admin model-quota set --family zephyr7b --tpm 1800 --rpm 108000 --reason "live mitigation 4487654321"
redwood-admin feature-toggle set --name funcall.disable --target-family zephyr7b --value true --ttl 1800
```
will run sequentially, confirm when applied.
alice-oncall: please run and paste output here.
carmen-runtime: running now...
deploy-bot: EXECUTE start: redwood-admin model-quota set --family zephyr7b --tpm 1800 --rpm 108000
deploy-bot: EXECUTE success: quota update applied (txn id: tx-9f3b)
deploy-bot: EXECUTE start: redwood-admin feature-toggle set --name funcall.disable --target-family zephyr7b --value true --ttl 1800
deploy-bot: EXECUTE success: feature toggle applied (txn id: ft-3a7c)
carmen-runtime: done — quotas lowered and funcall paused. rolling averages should start to reflect within 30s-2m. I also disabled cross-region failover for zephyr7b to avoid extra load spikes (temp).
ben-sre: seeing queue lengths drop and CPU on the zephyr pool fall ~35% within 60s. 5xx rate trending down to 0.6%. good so far.
dan-custsuccess: Acera Inc acknowledged — they have a fallback to 'sylph7b' for PRD, no action required. FinRed got notified and will delay non-critical jobs.
alice-oncall: noting customer impact: degradation window started 4487654310, mitigation applied 4487654340. estimated residual impact minimal; will keep watch.
carmen-runtime: set an automated rollback: if 5xx < 0.5% and median latency stable for 10m, we'll gradually restore TPM in steps: 1800 -> 3000 -> 5000 -> baseline. manual override allowed.
ben-sre: also caching TTLs were tuned in prod yesterday; might need longer KV warm window. adding an alert for cache-hit-rate < 70% in next 15m to avoid re-trigger.
elaine-oncall: picking up handoff in 10m. summary: quotas lowered and funcall paused for zephyr7b, customers notified (Acera, FinRed), queue and error rate improving. please add any outstanding actions.
alice-oncall: thumbs up. leave monitoring dashboards and logs open. if any customer escalates, escalate to SRE and CS immediately. :rotating_light: :thumbsup:
ben-sre: one follow-up: run a scan for long-lived streams (LL) against zephyr7b — if any clients are holding KV, we should break them. I'll run a quick script and report.
ben-sre: scan complete — 3 clients with >=30m open streams, sending automated close signal (graceful). that should further reduce memory pressure.
elaine-oncall: acknowledged, I'll keep the thread active until full restore. handing from @alice-oncall to @elaine-oncall for monitoring 30m post-mitigation. leave notes in incident log.
alice-oncall: handing over. ty everyone.
deploy-bot: INCIDENT NOTE: mitigation actions recorded: tx-9f3b, ft-3a7c, close-streams s-44b. log id: inc-4487654321
incident-bot: MONITORING: Will re-alert if 5xx > 0.8% or TPM > 2500 for zephyr7b within next 20m.
